verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs describe it as an AI app-builder that generates code, database schemas, and UI from natural-language prompts, and offers direct SQL access, but there is no evidence of the product itself surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's data (e.g., dashboards, analytics, or automated data commentary) inside the app-building experience. The closest mentions (database creation, SQL editor, 'AI' listed as a Cloud feature) describe infrastructure, not insight generation.
